properties.name: Klamath & Six Rivers Region
properties.description: Unified watershed boundary combining the Klamath River basin (incl. Trinity) with the Smith, Mad-Redwood, and Eel River (Upper, Middle Fork, South Fork, Lower) HUC8 subbasins.
properties.source: USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset (WBD) HUC8, California region 18, dissolved union; Klamath basin from USFWS Region 8 R8_FAC_Klamath_Basin_WFL1. Interior seam slivers from combining the two source vintages removed.
